title: Murray Stahl | CEO & Chairman of Horizon Kinetics
summary:
Murray is a human encyclopedia, author, and was an early investor in bitcoin, investing more than $700,000 in bitcoin in 2015. In this episode, you will learn about multiple economic theories, cryptocurrency, and individuals through history who have found intriguing ways to financial prosperity.
